items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: Oliver was a wonderful trumpet player, or something like that

ctx.x: I think, I mean, I think that he just said the same thing, yeah, Oliver was a wonderful trumpet player, or something like that, but, uh, Aside from that, nothing. Nothing.
I don't know. That tune, Please, I never did hear him play that myself.
